rows.label: tlk70000073_05_msg0001
rows.name:
I have to say, that was some
solid work you did there.

rows.label: tlk70000073_05_msg0002
rows.name:
Even in an emergency like this, the
people in the capital are standing
together and keeping morale high.

rows.label: tlk70000073_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Thanks to that, it got me
wondering how they're doing
over at the resistance camp.

rows.label: tlk70000073_05_msg0004
rows.name:
That time was fun in its own way. It's
a shame I don't have anything to
report anymore.

rows.label: tlk70000073_05_msg0005
rows.name:
It's true what they say.
You don't know what you
have till you lose it.

rows.label: tlk70000073_05_msg0006
rows.name:
Ahh... I meant to live
a little more wisely than this...

rows.label: tlk70000073_05_msg0008
rows.name:
Say... How long do you think a person
can start life over? Is there still
time even for me?
